Match the rose's muted antique-gold color and subtle texture in image 2, approximately midtone RGB(204,164,82), hex #CCA452. The gold in image 1 is too bright yellow: reduce that brightness/saturation back to the original antique gold. Change only gold color/texture. Keep image 1's exact rose geometry, all edge positions, angle, framing, size and the clean pure white background entirely unchanged. Do not redraw, simplify, add, remove, rotate, crop, or add outlines/shadows/halos. Output an opaque PNG of the same square composition.
